cause.label: equity_offering
cause.what_happened: On 2026-09-29 at 08:00 ET Beasley priced a $5.0m registered direct (200,000 shares plus 157,000 pre-funded warrants at $14.00) with $15 warrants to a single institutional investor via A.G.P. The deal closed 2026-09-30. The stock has fallen every session since: about -2.7% on 9/29, -9.44% on 9/30 and -12.4% by 15:04 ET today, to $11.26, about 20% under the deal price. No other news on 2026-10-01; the only item is a Radio Ink write-up of the deal.

evidence.claim: Pricing release: 357,000 shares and pre-funded warrants at $14.00, $15 warrants, closing on or about 9/30
Pre-market down 7.47% at $13.50 after the pricing, following a -4.58% Monday
8-K: offering closed 2026-09-30; Item 3.02 for the warrants; D&O 60-day lock-up
424B5: 1,019,614 Class A shares outstanding before the deal, 1,219,614 after (excluding the pre-funded warrants)

pipeline.next_dated_event: None found inside the window. The D&O lock-up and the company's 60-day issuance standstill run from 2026-09-30. The PIK-note springing-maturity test is 2026-09-30-2027 and the first PIK interest date is 2027-04-30. The next earnings date of 2026-11-09 is a Zacks estimate only.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A filing or print showing the RDO investor has finished selling (for example volume well above 357k shares cumulatively since 9/29), or a Form 4 insider buy filed tonight.

positioning_check: Nasdaq/FINRA: 102,085 shares short at the 2026-09-15 settlement, up 51.6% from 67,327 on 08-31, days to cover 1.47 on 69,646 ADV. That is about 10% of the ~1.02m Class A shares outstanding (10-Q cover; there are also 833,137 Class B shares). The figure is about eight business days stale and predates the 9/29 deal, so the position carried into the fall is unobservable. No options market, so no skew. Insiders: 0 open-market buys and 1 sale over 3 months (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/company/BBGI/insider-trades).

findings.finding: 357,000 freshly registered BBGI shares (200k common plus 157k immediately exercisable pre-funded warrants) were delivered to one institutional investor at the 2026-09-30 closing. That equals ~35% of the 1.02m Class A shares outstanding and ~8 sessions of September volume. Cumulative volume since the deal was announced is only ~161k shares (55.5k on 9/29, 71.6k on 9/30, ~34k by 15:04 ET on 10/1), so even if every traded share were theirs, at least ~196k remain to be sold into the 2026-10-02 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The shares are freely tradable since the 9/30 closing, and the holder sits ~20% under its $14.00 cost with the $15 warrants not exercisable for six months. Remaining supply therefore lands in the next session, not later.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baseline own falls: 2026-06-12 (the day a 424B5 offering was filed) fell -24.51% and then -1.24% next close. 2026-09-30, the closing day of this deal, fell -9.44% and was followed by today's -12.37%. Both offering-linked falls continued rather than bounced, against a 51% up rate over all 37 comparable falls.
findings.why_not_priced: The price fell on normal volume (0.99x). If the overhang were cleared, cumulative volume since 9/29 would exceed the 357k delivered. It is under half of that, so the remaining block is not in the close. That the investor is the seller is an inference from RDO practice and the timing (the fall accelerated on the delivery day), not a disclosed fact, so it carries a modest share.
findings.independence: Daily volumes from Yahoo chart v8, truncated at 2026-10-01 00:00 UTC in the URL (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/BBGI?period1=1788220800&period2=1790812800&interval=1d). Short interest rose 51.6% into 9/15 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/BBGI/short-interest?assetclass=stocks).

findings.finding: The placement agent agreement bars the company from issuing or announcing new common stock or equivalents for 60 days after the 2026-09-30 closing, and from variable-rate deals for 180 days. The prior Noble ATM was terminated effective 2026-09-27 after selling only 35,600 shares. No second issuer offering can therefore price tonight.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The standstill is in force throughout the window (2026-09-30 to about 2026-11-29). It removes the commonest second-shoe, an overnight issuer offering, from the 2026-10-02 session.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior standstill observed in the baseline. The last two issuer financings (June ATM/424B5, Sept RDO) both preceded continued falls.
findings.why_not_priced: A small offset. The exhibit was filed after the 9/30 close and a thin tape may not distinguish investor supply from issuer supply. If the market were pricing a fresh issuer raise, the fall would be on heavier volume. The exhibit's ATM carve-out is ambiguous, which keeps this small.

outside_window.finding: The 2027 PIK notes ($98.5m at 6/30) convert into 95% of fully diluted Class A plus Class B equity at the holders' election on an Event of Default, at the springing maturity (no binding refinancing or asset-sale agreements by 2026-09-30-2027), or after 2027-12-31. Going-concern language is still in the 10-Q. This is a long-dated tail on the equity.
Nasdaq audit-committee composition deficiency (Rule 5605(c)(2)(A)) after the death of director Peter A. Bordes, Jr. on 2026-09-19; the cure period runs to the next annual meeting or 2027-09-19.
The $15.00 common warrants (357,000) become exercisable about 2027-03-30 and are an overhang above the price.

baseline_tension: Cuts against the volume signal (0.99x, where the under-2x base rate is +1.46%) and this name's own 51% up-rate over 37 falls, and agrees with its two offering-linked falls, both of which continued; for that reason p_up is held at 42 rather than lower.
